verdict.rationale: Authy's documentation offers only encrypted cloud backup and multi-device sync, with no export of TOTP secrets in any open format. Community reports say there is no export option and that Twilio deliberately makes migration hard. The only extraction routes mentioned are unofficial hacks: injecting JavaScript into a deprecated Chrome extension or running the desktop app in debug mode, which has since been EOL'd. Even extracted secrets for Authy-managed services can be regenerated and stop working, so this is lock-in rather than portability.
